notes.area_covered: Share of the zone (fence + radius) where 3+ tower-sensor pairs detect the drone, or 2+ microphones hear it.
notes.accuracy: Median expected position error over the covered area; rough (within ~2x of the full simulation).
notes.time_tracked: Scored-flight estimate: 20 random contraband flights at the chosen height, share of in-zone time with a held track.
notes.interference: dB of interference from neighboring cells on the same carrier that the processing removes: 20 = current assumption; 40 = rebuilding and subtracting neighbor cells (unproven).
notes.update: One position update per processed frame: every 1.5 s (0.8 s integration).
